newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Zaire's warring sides to meet "shortly" - S.Africa.
newsitem.headline: Zaire's warring sides to meet "shortly" - S.Africa.

text.p: Face-to-face talks between Zaire's ailing President Mobutu Sese Seko and rebel leader Laurent Kabila will take place "shortly", South Africa said on Tuesday.
"The talks will take place shortly...it will be a meeting between President Mobutu and Laurent Kabila," Pieter Swanepoel, spokesman for the Department of Foreign Affairs, told Reuters.
Swanepoel said the talks would be presided over by President Nelson Mandela and followed extensive consultation with both the rebels and Mobutu's government.
Earlier, a South African newspaper said the talks could be held on one of the country's warships in international waters, but Swanepoel said no venue or date had been set.
